about: Hand-built pairs for the two classic clustering failures. same=false pairs must end in different stories (over-merging), same=true pairs in one story (under-merging). Events are invented and dated a week after items.json, so they are judged with a real corpus's word weights but cannot be absorbed by a real story. Each item gives only what matters; the test fills in the rest. Times are UTC.
